SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN n.status = 'done' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS done, SUM(CASE WHEN n.status = 'updating' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS updating, SUM(CASE WHEN n.updated_at >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS month FROM note_note n WHERE n.deleted = 0
